full_judgment: 25. On close analysis of the impugned judgment, it appears to us that the learned Judge of the Court below convicted the appellant only for the cause of his absconcion and according to him the absconcion is a ground for presumption of guilt. The view taken by the learned Judge is absolutely an erroneous view.
